meta.parties: Cassim Et Al. v. Peria Tamby Et Al

rules.statement: A will of a 'Mussulman native' under the Charter of 1801 should be construed according to the laws and usages of the Mussulmans, as provided by clause 32 of that Charter.
rules.supporting_quote: "The will of a person falling under the designation "Mussulman native", as used in the Charter of 1801, must be construed, not according to the Roman-Dutch Law, but according to the laws and usages of the Mussulmans, as provided by clause 32 of that Charter."
